report:
Pancreas, head of pancreas, enucleation

Received in formalin is an enucleation specimen measuring 15 x 12 x 10 mm. The surface is inked and the specimen is serially sliced. There is a firm, ill-defined pale tumour centred on the head of pancreas measuring 9 x 8 x 7 mm. Representative sections are taken; see block key.

Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Excisional biopsy (enucleation)
- Tumour site: Head of pancreas
- Tumour size: 0.9 cm (unifocal invasive carcinoma, greatest dimension)

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Ductal adenocarcinoma, NOS
- Histologic grade: G2, moderately differentiated
- Tumour histology:
  The tumour is a moderately differentiated ductal adenocarcinoma, NOS, confined to the pancreas. Haphazardly arranged infiltrating glands with incomplete lumina and luminal necrotic debris are set in abundant desmoplastic stroma, lying immediately adjacent to muscular vessels and nerves, and show marked variation in nuclear size within individual glands. The tumour cells express CK7. There is loss of nuclear SMAD4 (DPC4) expression.
- Sites involved by direct extension: Confined to pancreas
- Pancreatic surface involvement: Not identified
- Lymphovascular invasion: Not identified
- Perineural invasion: Not identified
- Treatment effect: No known presurgical therapy
- Precursor lesion: Pancreatic intraepithelial neoplasia, high grade (PanIN)

Margins
- Pancreatic parenchymal margin: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma, 0.4 mm
- High-grade dysplasia at the margins: Not identified

Pathological stage (AJCC 8th edition)
- pTNM: pT1b

Additional findings
- Chronic pancreatitis

PANCREAS, head of pancreas, enucleation
- DUCTAL ADENOCARCINOMA, NOS, moderately differentiated, 0.9 cm, confined to the
  pancreas; pancreatic parenchymal margin 0.4 mm (margin positive at 1 mm or
  less); see synoptic report
- pT1b (AJCC 8th edition)

checks.message: Pancreatic parenchymal margin is 0.4 mm from the carcinoma; at 1 mm or less this is reported as a positive margin (R1) in pancreatobiliary resections.
